relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED from front matter (arXiv identifier and subject match the registered entry). LOAD-BEARING AND VERIFIED at both citation sites, and unusually the sites make checkable claims ABOUT the source rather than merely borrowing from it. (1) rem:ks-finiteness-via-diamond-lemma asserts that the authors 'must assume ind-constructibility to measure their 3CY moduli stacks'. Verified: the term occurs 99 times in the PDF, §3 is titled 'Ind-constructible categories and stability structures', and §3.1 states that all A_infty-categories in the paper will be ind-constructible. The claim is accurate. (2) rem:ks-multiplicativity-via-markov asserts the counting map is a monoid homomorphism via the motivic Hall algebra and offers a two-line Markov-trace recovery for the disjoint-union monoid; the multiplicative wall-crossing formula is §1.4 of the document's own contents, consistent with that framing. The registered entry's rigor caveat (many proofs are sketches; admit to QOU content only if Lean-backable) is well placed, and both citing blocks are remarks rather than theorems, which respects it.
